scripts.deploy:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.html')){console.error('✗ No dist/index.html — run pnpm build first.');process.exit(1);}const t=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8').match(/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/);console.log('✓ dist/index.html title:',t?t[1]:'(none)');console.log('✓ cwd:',p.basename(process.cwd()));console.log('  → If the title or cwd look wrong, do NOT deploy. cd to the right project first.');"
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:check && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.pdf:all: node scripts/export-pdf.mjs --page=launch-plan && node scripts/export-pdf.mjs --page=proposal && node scripts/export-pdf.mjs --page=/ --out=Wonderful-Japan-Strategy.pdf
